notes: Cuts, motion, captions and encoding run with ffmpeg 8.x from winget (Gyan.FFmpeg); captions are drawn with the bundled OFL Pretendard, converted to TTF inside the work folder when drawtext needs it.

steps.does: Write the cut list with timecodes, framing, motion, captions and music cues from the supplied footage or photos and the brief.

Cut and render video/final.mp4 with ffmpeg and write the captions to video/final.srt. Fill the whole frame at the target aspect (crop the subject in, or a blurred fill of the same shot; never a small picture on a flat color), give stills slow movement (zoompan or a crop pan) with short crossfades between shots, set captions large and bold with an outline or shadow that reads over a busy photo, inside the platform safe area, then extract a frame every two seconds and look at them before finishing.

steps.ask: The operator watches the whole video and confirms the music licence before delivery.
